tools.name: eacc_get_latest
tools.description: Get the latest e/acc items for a 24-hour or 7-day briefing. Prefer selected mode unless the user explicitly asks for every public item. Do not use this for named-topic search or multi-source event context.

tools.name: eacc_search
tools.description: Search e/acc's latest 7 days by a 2–200 character topic, company, model, product, or person. It searches editorial picks first and automatically expands to all public items only when picks have no result.

tools.name: eacc_get_hot_topics
tools.description: Get the current e/acc Top 10 with each event's one-based rank. Use this for 'what is hot now' and to discover valid story public IDs; use eacc_get_latest for a chronological news list. Internal heat scores are not returned.

tools.name: eacc_get_story
tools.description: Get the evolving timeline, latest development, AI digest, and related events for one public story. Only pass a public_id obtained from eacc_get_hot_topics links.story; never invent or infer IDs.

tools.name: eacc_get_daily
tools.description: Get e/acc's edited daily overview, either the latest issue or a real YYYY-MM-DD date. Use this when the user asks for a daily report rather than a raw chronological list.

tools.name: eacc_get_weekly
tools.description: Get e/acc's edited weekly report: the week's most important events chosen from its dailies, grouped by section, with an overview. Use this for what happened this week or in a given ISO week; omit week for the latest.

tools.name: eacc_get_monthly
tools.description: Get e/acc's edited monthly report: the month's most important events chosen from its dailies, grouped by section, with an overview. Use this for what happened this month or in a given month; omit month for the latest.

tools.name: eacc_get_cost_of_intelligence
tools.description: The cost-of-intelligence index: for each GPQA Diamond threshold, the cheapest first-party API price (blended USD per million tokens) at which a model at or above it could be bought, how many times cheaper it has become, and how many months the price takes to halve.

tools.name: eacc_wallpaper_today
tools.description: Today's public wallpaper preview and product page. No key or credit required.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "eacc_search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search e/acc's latest 7 days by a 2–200 character topic, company, model, product, or person. It searches editorial picks first and automatically expands to all public items only when picks have no result." → after: "Search e/acc by a 2–200 character topic, company, model, product, or person, over the latest 7 days by default or 30 days with window=30d. It searches editorial picks first and automatically expands to all public items only when picks have no result."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "eacc_get_story" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get the evolving timeline, latest development, AI digest, and related events for one public story. Only pass a public_id obtained from eacc_get_hot_topics links.story; never invent or infer IDs." → after: "Get the evolving timeline, latest development, AI digest, and related events for one public story. Pass the Story public_id or story link that eacc_get_hot_topics returned; never invent or infer IDs."

remediation.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
